name_en: AHF Thailand (AIDS Healthcare Foundation)
evidence_quotes: การให้คำปรึกษา ตรวจหาการติดเชื้อเอชไอวี โรคติดต่อทางเพศสัมพันธ์ และส่งต่อเข้าสู่ระบบบริการโดยความร่วมมือกับองค์กรชุมชน และหน่วยงานภาครัฐ
notes: Own About page lists ผู้ให้บริการทางเพศ among groups. AHF says it has no own clinics in Thailand; supports partner facilities (~50 partners across provinces, not named in sources seen). Bangkok office address published at aidshealth.org page.

name_en: Asia Pacific Network of Sex Workers (APNSW)
evidence_quotes: The network management is sex worker led, and membership consists primarily of sex worker led organisations.
notes: Regional network secretariat in Bangkok; no direct HIV/mental health service seen, advocacy/networking only. Evidence page is a third-party (CGSHE) page; Facebook page confirms Bangkok. Thai members not listed in results.

name_en: Bangkok Metropolitan Administration primary health centres - key population outreach (PrEP, counselling and testing)

evidence_quotes: all of the city’s 68 primary health centres have integrated outreach programmes that provide counselling and testing for gay men and other men who have sex with men, transgender people, male and female sex workers
notes: Evidence is a UNAIDS Fast-Track Cities page, not a BMA page. Says 15 BMA centres provide PrEP and nonoccupational PEP. Individual centres are not listed here. Checker should find which centres offer the service.

notes: STI service confirmed by news page only; no own page or official document naming sex workers found (PMC article on MSM/TG program mentions Bangrak as a referral site). Sex worker link is a gap; checker to decide. Facebook URL appeared in fast-trackcities.org listing.

notes: Services confirmed (DDC page lists Bangrak clinic, tel 0 2286 2465, Facebook BangrakSTIsCenter, free HIV testing). Sex worker link only indirect: launch article names the sex worker foundation (มูลนิธิเพื่อนพนักงานบริการ) and RSAT as partners; not shown that Bangrak itself names sex workers as a served group. Evidence is a news page. Needs manual check for sex worker mention.

Checker should confirm sex worker connection. Bangkok address on Facebook is published by the org page (not recorded here).

notes: Evidence is a 2013 journal article (not org page); Global Fund civil-society principal recipient also per UNAIDS PCB51 case study. notes: Red Cross-affiliated (quasi-governmental).
